# Unwind

Unwind is a privacy-focused mental wellness web application designed to provide supportive wellness tools without replacing professional medical care.

## Main Features

- Wellness Dashboard
- AI Companion
- Private Journal
- DASS-21 Self-Assessment
- Wellness Trackers
- Community Posts
- Public Chat
- Private Rooms
- Direct Messaging
- Notifications
- Account and Privacy Settings

## Important Pages

- [Unwind Home](https://project-unwind-mu.vercel.app/)
- [Login](https://project-unwind-mu.vercel.app/login)
- [Register](https://project-unwind-mu.vercel.app/register)

## About

Unwind focuses on privacy, emotional wellbeing, journaling, self-reflection and supportive community interaction.

The platform does not provide medical diagnosis or emergency healthcare services.
